title: Goofy Ahh Dora
blurb: Childhood educational programming, deep-fried well past the point of map-reading capability. Turning kids' TV into brainrot is a fully established genre by now, and Dora is its patron saint because she is familiar enough that everybody clocks her instantly while still giving the distortion something to push against. A voice engineered to soothe and reassure, run through compression that makes it sound transmitted from inside a washing machine: the collision is where the laugh lives. Swiper, regrettably, could not stop the audio quality from going.
